result.title: StreamVibe: Proactive Video Agents for Evolving User Intent
result.summary: Vision-language models are shifting from offline passive understanding toward online proactive interaction. However, prevailing methods largely rely on explicit requests while miss the implicit user intent (e.g., "where should I click next?" while a user navigate a website), meanwhile fail to update the state simultaneously as user requests might update continuously. These limitations make them less suited to intent-aware interaction in practical. To address these challenges, we introduce StreamVibe-Bench, a new benchmark serving as testbed for user intent interaction, with 4.1K evaluation samples and 85K training samples spanning explicit, implicit, and dynamic intents. Building on this benchmark, we develop StreamVibe-VL, a streaming proactive model that infers implicit user intents from continuous observations and dynamically tailors its interactions as these intents evolve. We further introduce StreamVibe-Harness, which maintains user intents as persistent states with a fleixble lifecycles via a hierarchical memory to track the latest user intent and environmental state. Our experiments reveal three key findings: (i) StreamVibe-VL preserves strong general video understanding while improving response timing and answer quality by 10.7% over other baselines; (ii) existing proactive models remain limited in understanding user intent and deciding when to respond, especially under implicit and dynamic intents; and (iii) StreamVibe-Harness further improves response consistency and adaptation over sustained interaction, resulting in a 12.3% gain in proactive interaction.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 StreamVibe-Bench（4.1K 评测样本、85K 训练样本，覆盖显式、隐式与动态用户意图），并提出流式主动模型 StreamVibe-VL 及用分层记忆将用户意图维护为持续状态的 StreamVibe-Harness。
AI.relevance_reason: 「何时响应」的决策可作为 LVR 中 STOP 决策与动态计算的对照线索，分层记忆中的意图持久状态也可能供核查状态更新与信念维护方式；但任务为流式视频主动交互，与潜空间视觉推理仍有距离，需进一步读原文确认。
